# tplinkeasysmart_vlan_port_based (Data Source)

Port-based VLAN mode and groups (VLAN > Port Based VLAN). Read-only: VLAN changes can cut management access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_vlan_port_based" "this" {}

output "port_vlans" {
  value = data.tplinkeasysmart_vlan_port_based.this.vlans
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `switch` (String) Name of the switch (a key of the provider's `switches` map) this object lives on. Required when the provider has a `switches` map; `default` is the provider's own switch (`host`) beside it. Omit it when the provider has only its own switch.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether port-based VLAN mode is active.
- `id` (String) Always `vlan_port_based`.
- `max_vlans` (Number) Maximum number of VLAN groups.
- `vlans` (Attributes List) The port-based VLAN groups that exist, with their member ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))

<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) VLAN group id.
- `ports` (List of Number) Member ports.
